request.style: English, blues, male solo voice with deep baritone character, acoustic guitar, piano, upright bass, brushed snare drum, moody and contemplative, 80 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
A hundred and twenty gathered round
Peter stood up among the crowd
Brothers listen to the word
The Scripture had to be fulfilled by God

[Chorus]
Cast the lots for the empty place
Let the choice fall in this sacred space
The lot fell to Matthias
He takes the seat of the missing one

[Verse]
From John the Baptist's holy stream
To the day He was taken from us by dream
They must be witnesses of the rise
Of the Lord who ascended into the skies

[Chorus]
Cast the lots for the empty place
Let the choice fall in this sacred space
The lot fell to Matthias
He takes the seat of the missing one

[Verse]
Joseph called Barsabbas stood near
Justus waited in the gathering air
They prayed to the Lord who sees all
Show us which one you are calling to call

[Chorus]
Cast the lots for the empty place
Let the choice fall in this sacred space
The lot fell to Matthias
He takes the seat of the missing one

[Outro]
He was added to the eleven now
The witness ministry is restored somehow
